regions.today: Dry this evening with sunny spells, in a mostly light easterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with some areas of mist and fog. Mild and humid with temperatures not falling below 13 to 16 degrees, in light winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Thursday, will start off dry in many areas. However, rain in the south will push northwards through afternoon and evening, becoming heavy at times, especially in the south and east, with the chance of thunderstorms and intense downpours bringing the potential for surface flooding here. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees with a mostly light northeast breeze.
